feature_definitions.candidate_acceptor_is_n_terminal_sty: Nearest hydroxyl residue is Ser/Thr/Tyr within the first five resolved residues of its chain.
feature_definitions.candidate_chain_has_own_nucleotide_or_me: A nucleotide-like ligand or metal is assigned to the candidate chain ID, excluding the selected nucleotide residue.
feature_definitions.nearest_nonpolymer_oxygen_distance_angst: Minimum distance from selected gamma-equivalent atom to any non-water HETATM oxygen outside the selected nucleotide residue.
feature_definitions.nearest_protein_hydroxyl_distance_angstr: Minimum distance from any terminal gamma-equivalent atom to any resolved Ser OG, Thr OG1, or Tyr OH atom.
feature_definitions.nearest_strict_cross_chain_candidate: Nearest compact hydroxyl pair satisfying the strict rule preconditions; null means no such source-free candidate.
feature_definitions.polymer_entity_count_sequence_proxy: Count of distinct resolved ATOM residue-name sequences across chains.
feature_definitions.reciprocal_cross_chain_topology: Selected nearest gamma/hydroxyl pair spans two chains; no source role assignment is implied.
feature_definitions.terminal_gamma_equivalent_atom_available: A nucleotide-like nonpolymer residue has atom PG or P3 in model 1.
